text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Due to renovations at Nakayama Racecourse, this year's Satsuki Sho was held at Tokyo Racecourse, just like the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...The first leg of the Tokyo-held Classics,
the Satsuki Sho, is about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"It looks like Yaeno-san has leaned out her body even more.
This is probably peak condition for her."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ......*inhale*~... *exhale*~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, I'm hopeless.
And here I thought I wouldn't get nervous.
choice_data_list: I have someone I refuse to lose to, so it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to win.
Because I don't want to lose to my rivals."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to win.
And I've been giving it everything I have for that."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to win...!
To get closer to my dream than anyone else...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I am heading out!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Everywhere I look, it's packed with people...
Everyone's squished together... it's so crowded.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...This is the Classics.
A place where everyone only gets one chance to set foot."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: My body is... so hot, and I haven't even started running yet.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Yaeno-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"You were an Umamusume running ahead of me.
With fierce intensity burning in your eyes."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "That's precisely why I honed my skills. In order to surpass you."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Leading up to this once-in-a-lifetime stage.
Condensing every thirst, every single feeling within oneself.
So that when the contest comes, the hill can be conquered a few strides ahead.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have honed and prepared myself.
All to repay the debt of gratitude I owe my master.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "However, there are things I cannot yield on either. No matter how strong an Umamusume you might be."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If you consider me a rival...
If you intend to rob me of the "special" I strive for...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Right here, right now, I will claim victory over you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Our battle will surely
be over in the blink of an eye."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In just one race,
our "Satsuki Sho" will be decided forever.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that is precisely why
this single race is—"

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Yaeno
text_block_list.text:
—I won't lose to you!
—I will not lose to you!
